item.title: French taxpayers warned after personal data stolen in major hack
item.description: More than 670,000 French taxpayers are being notified after their personal and tax information was stolen and allegedly offered online. Authorities warn the data could be used for scams and identity fraud, while Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is holding a meeting on the digital security of government institutions. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Trump’s Gaza plan: What is at stake for Netanyahu?
item.description: The Trump administration is stepping up diplomatic efforts to secure a peace plan for Gaza. US envoy Jared Kushner is set to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a bid to persuade him to back the proposal. With Netanyahu facing major political and personal stakes ahead of a possible re-election, FRANCE 24’s Philip Turle examines whether the meeting could bring a breakthrough in Gaza and analyses what is at stake for all sides. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Malaysia to scrap 55-year-old university law, but will campus reform follow?
item.description: Malaysia may finally scrap the university law that generations of students have blamed for stifling campus dissent, but activists and academics say the harder fight will be over what comes next. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has promised to abolish the Universities and University Colleges Act 1971, better known by its Malay acronym AUKU, a law that has long sat at the centre of arguments over how much freedom Malaysian students should have to protest, organise and challenge university... To international onlookers, Pedro Sánchez appears to have achieved the impossible. Where other European leftist and left-ish premiers have flopped and flailed, the Spanish PM has endured. Since June 2018, Sánchez has ruled from Madrid, implementing a raft of progressive policies. item.description: Los colonos israelíes cumplen siete días de asedio contra los habitantes de la aldea palestina de Qusra, en Cisjordania ocupada. Bajo presión de Estados Unidos, el Gobierno de Benjamin Netanyahu ordenó el despliegue del ejército en la zona, pero algunos palestinos denuncian que las fuerzas israelíes no han logrado detener las acciones de los colonos y consideran que su presencia es prácticamente simbólica. Mientras tanto, los suministros comienzan a agotarse y algunos colonos israelíes han llegado a cortar el suministro de agua a varias viviendas. Publicado también por: France 24 - Español. Fuente: France 24 Español.

item.title: ¿Cuál es el panorama de Lula y Bolsonaro en sus campañas para la presidencia de Brasil?
item.description: Empezaron las campañas presidenciales de los 13 candidatos de la primera vuelta en Brasil. El presidente actual, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, y el hijo del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio Bolsonaro, quienes lideran la intención de voto, realizaron sus primeros mítines junto a sus seguidores este 16 de agosto. Analizamos el panorama de Lula y Bolsonaro con Juan Agulló, doctor en Sociología por la EHESS de París. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
